entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A Spartan-inspired polis high in the Katachthon Mountains on Theros, home to the most feared warriors of the plane.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of gods and poleis on which Akros stands.

entities.name: Agnomakhos
entities.description: The archon tyrant overthrown by Kynaios and Tiro.

entities.name: Kynaios
entities.description: A human hero who overthrew Agnomakhos with Ephara's help.

entities.name: Tiro
entities.description: A human hero who overthrew Agnomakhos with Ephara's help.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: The god who inspired and equipped Kynaios and Tiro.

entities.name: Elektes
entities.description: The first king of Akros, who founded it with six other warriors inspired by Iroas.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: The god of Victory whose martial doctrine inspired Akros's founders and who favors the Akroans.

entities.name: Kytheon Iora
entities.description: An Akroan orphan and gang leader trained in hieromancy who made his first planeswalk to Bant and became the planeswalker Gideon Jura.

entities.name: Hixus
entities.description: The prison warden who taught Kytheon hieromancy and freed the prisoners to defend the Kolophon.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The god who championed Kytheon against the titan of Erebos.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The god who deflected Kytheon's spear, killing his irregulars, and who offered a reward for the location of Kytheon's soul.

entities.name: Kolophon
entities.description: Akros's many-tiered fortress and seat of power which has never fallen to an enemy.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A satyr planeswalker who besieged Akros with minotaurs and staged the Great Revel to attain godhood.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrived at Akros during the siege and saved King Anax.

entities.name: Cymede
entities.description: The queen of Akros who offered herself to Keranos, ascended to Nyx and was later compleated.

entities.name: Anax
entities.description: The king of Akros, gravely wounded by Rhordon, who died and later returned as a demigod champion of Purphoros.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: An oracle who helped Cymede raise the Deyda River against the minotaur camp.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: The god of Storms who transformed the river into an elemental that consumed the minotaurs and claimed Cymede.

entities.name: Rhordon the Rageblood
entities.description: An oracle of Mogis who impaled Anax and was washed away by the river elemental.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: The god of slaughter who sent a minotaur horde and aided Rhordon.

entities.name: Great Revel
entities.description: The victory celebration used by Xenagos as the final ritual to godhood.

entities.name: Taranika
entities.description: Anax and Cymede's niece, regent of Akros.

entities.name: Akroan War
entities.description: A decades-long siege of Akros by the Olantian king, recounted in an epic poem.

entities.name: Olantin
entities.description: A polis that later sank beneath the sea, whose king besieged Akros.

entities.name: Gideon's memorial
entities.description: A monument outside Akros where Gideon's breastplate was buried and an oak planted by Nissa.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who planted an acorn into an oak at Gideon's memorial.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A planeswalker who sang a eulogy for Gideon.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A Phyrexian planeswalker who led the first wave of the invasion on Theros.

entities.name: Lektoi
entities.description: The warrior class at the apex of Akroan society, claiming descent from the seven founding warriors.

entities.name: Stratians
entities.description: The wandering warrior bands that form Akros's military.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: The god of the Forge, whose champion Anax became.

events.summary: Elektes and six warriors, inspired by Iroas, found Akros after the war between humans and minotaurs.
events.quote: Elektes and six other warriors, inspired by the martial doctrine of Iroas , established the polis of Akros, with Elektes as its first king.

events.summary: The king of Olantin besieges Akros for decades after his queen leaves him for the Akroan king.
events.quote: What followed was a siege that stretched on for decades.

events.summary: Kytheon Iora leads a gang stealing from the rich and is imprisoned, where Hixus teaches him hieromancy.
events.quote: The prison warden, a man named Hixus , taught him Hieromancy, the magic of order.

events.summary: Kytheon saves the Kolophon from harpies and cyclopes, defeats the titan of Erebos with Heliod's spear, then throws the spear at Erebos, who kills his irregulars; Kytheon first planeswalks to Bant and becomes Gideon Jura.
events.quote: Shocked and shamed by their deaths at his hand, Kytheon then made his first planeswalk to Bant, where he became known as Gideon Jura.

events.summary: Xenagos besieges Akros with minotaurs and the Akroans capture him.
events.quote: Queen Cymede informed them that the Akroans had captured the satyr Xenagos

events.summary: Cymede offers herself to Keranos, who turns the Deyda River into an elemental that consumes the minotaurs; she ascends to Nyx.
events.quote: Cymede was claimed by Keranos as she transformed into a pillar of fire and crimson light and ascended into Nyx

events.summary: Rhordon, aided by Mogis, impales King Anax; Elspeth saves Anax, and Rhordon is washed away by the river.
events.quote: The Rageblood quickly defeated Anax by impaling the king through the stomach.

events.summary: Xenagos uses the victory celebration to stage the Great Revel and ascend to godhood.
events.quote: Xenagos used the occasion to stage the Great Revel , the final ritual that propelled him to godhood

events.summary: After the Great Revel Anax dies, Cymede is missing, and their niece Taranika becomes regent.
events.quote: the responsibility of leadership fell to their niece, Taranika , who serves as regent

events.summary: Grieving planeswalkers bury Gideon's breastplate outside Akros as a memorial and Nissa grows an oak.
events.quote: Nissa Revane planted an acorn and grew it into a massive oak tree next to the stone

events.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion, the gods and their devotees are compleated and Akros is presumed to have fallen.
events.quote: Akros is presumed to have fallen as a metropolis.

prison warden and mentor of Kytheon
he was championed by the God Heliod

relations.note: Killed his irregulars and sought his soul.
relations.quote: Erebos set up a reward for anyone who could tell him.
the king's niece, Taranika , acts as regent

relations.note: Claimed her after she offered herself.
relations.quote: Cymede offered herself to Keranos in exchange for his assistance
